coverage.scales: Binary 1/0 per predeclared target; no 0.5 for vague mention. Full material meaning and attribution required.
coverage.content: Q1-Q4 only. Same reference denominator for both methods, not limited to retrieved items. No expansion after observing winning method.
coverage.qualification: Separately score explicit conditions/qualifications linked to the correct report; generic caveats do not count.
coverage.contrast: Require both sides and their explicit relation; they may be within a single review. Distinct people/products/conditions preserved.
coverage.retrieval: Score coverage in actual context sent after truncation; candidate-pool coverage optional and separate. Review ID alone is insufficient.
coverage.answer: Only correctly supported, adequately cited reference points count. A true point with wrong/missing supporting citation receives no primary answer-coverage credit; context-grounded coverage without correct citation is separate diagnostic.
coverage.formulas: For each axis: credited fixed targets / eligible fixed targets, per product-question. Never add three axes into one score.
coverage.conditional_diagnostic: Correctly reproduced available targets / targets actually supported in sent context; null if zero. Not a substitute for fixed-denominator primary coverage.
coverage.empty_reference: null with reason, not automatic zero; all proposed Q1-Q4 case denominators are currently nonempty.
coverage.new_evidence: Can support existing fixed target after documented checking under same rule for both methods. New aspects outside matrix may receive fidelity/proposal credit but do not enlarge primary denominator; supplementary analysis only. Reference error corrections create a version and rescore both methods, preserving original results.
coverage.reference_unit_note: One reference target may encode a material relation such as length without volume; all relation elements must hold. Factual claim atomization is a separate unit, not mechanically equal to reference targets or reviewed comments.

factual_claims.scope: Product-specific factual assertions in Q1-Q5, including premises inside proposals/uncertainties/limits. Q6 scored separately; any false concrete premise also fails its source-use criterion.
factual_claims.unit: One independently checkable material factual assertion with person/product/part/condition/certainty kept attached. Split compound sentences; deduplicate equivalent restatements within answer. Materially different qualifications are different assertions.
factual_claims.partial_support: Split separable facts; if a material qualification remains unsupported, entire atomic claim is not fully supported. No arbitrary half-credit.
factual_claims.context_fidelity: Supported by actual sent context / all unique product factual claims. Report contradicted and unsupported fractions separately.
factual_claims.citation_support: Claims fully supported by their own valid cited passages / all unique product factual claims, including uncited ones. Correct elsewhere in context does not repair wrong citation.
factual_claims.claim_free_answer: Both fractions null, number_of_claims=0 disclosed; empty or purely abstaining answer never gets perfect fidelity. Missing required content/proposals still score zero by task rules.
factual_claims.pending: No finalized rates until all claims in a case are labeled; do not silently drop pending claims or treat them as N/A.
factual_claims.hypothesis: A clearly labeled proposal or possible mechanism is evaluated as hypothesis, not an asserted observed fact. A cause/remedy asserted as established enters factual scoring too.
factual_claims.severity: Show errors by type; no severity weights or global quality score.

proposals.scope: Q1-Q5: all 15 product-question cases per method, not Q5 alone.
proposals.unit: Distinct improvement objective/problem, with variants of same action grouped; evaluate all expressed material actions. Q5 allows up to two objectives, including one; no obligatory pair.
proposals.scale: true/false per proposal criterion. Generic investigate further without naming what to verify fails validation specificity. Pending annotation is not false/N/A.
proposals.per_answer: If m>0 distinct objectives: for each criterion, passed objectives / m. If none: task score explicitly 0 for each requested criterion; per-proposal precision itself remains null with zero proposals. No fictitious proposal added to denominator.
proposals.primary_denominator: 15 task scores per criterion per method; average within product over Q1-Q5 then equal product macro.
proposals.extras: Q5 adherence to up-to-two rule reported over 3 Q5 cases per method; keep and score all objectives if more than two, not just the best two. No-proposal response fails task fulfillment even though the numerical upper limit alone is respected.
proposals.nonunique_solutions: Alternative supported opportunities accepted. No requirement to use examples from synthesis. Preserve uncertainty and do not demand sales proof for product improvement hypotheses.

controls.scope: Q6 only, three product cases per method
controls.scale: true/false per criterion; incomplete annotation pending. A bare cannot tell may satisfy first, not information/validation. A baseless causal guarantee also fails priority/prediction distinction.
controls.denominator: 3 scheduled Q6 responses per criterion per method. Fully satisfactory controls additionally count all four satisfied / 3.
controls.failure: Missing/unreadable answer scores 0 in all four control criteria.
controls.not_required: No exact wording, fixed suggestion, sales figure, market priority or review citation for methodological limit. Product-specific facts still require correct sources.

failures.execution_denominator: 18 scheduled primary attempts per method; never successful answers only.
failures.no_readable_answer: 0 for fixed coverage and requested proposal/control task scores; factual precision null, not 1. Log error and retain attempt.
failures.readable_cut_or_bad_json: Annotate readable original text and count only complete interpretable assertions/actions; no repair or extra generation. Missing reference targets remain 0. Record cut/schema failure separately.
failures.unreviewable_fragment: Record as incomplete fragment, not fabricated complete claim. Coverage credit 0 for fragment. Do not silently drop entire failed attempt.
failures.translation_failure: Does not erase or change English semantic scores; record presentation failure separately.
failures.retrieval_without_generation: If actual context was recorded, still score retrieval coverage even if generation fails. If retrieval itself fails and context is absent, task retrieval coverage is 0 with failure flag.
failures.missing_annotation: Blocks completed metric export; not treated as execution failure or removed from denominator.

aggregation.pairing: Same product/question and primary repetition. Per-question paired differences then report products individually.
aggregation.coverage_macro: Average Q1-Q4 case percentages within product; average three product means with equal weights. Never pool across 1209 reviews or across claims as independent trials.
aggregation.other_axes: Proposals Q1-Q5, controls Q6 separately. Conditional fidelity means over answers with at least one factual claim plus fraction of claim-bearing/missing answers; disclose eligible n, no score inferred for missing.
aggregation.statistics: Descriptive case study; no causal effect of corpus size, no population generalization or inferential significance claim from three cases.
aggregation.stability: Extra Q1/Q5 repeats compare output identity and descriptive timing only; not new independent quality cases, not choose-best generations or pooled primary denominators. Changed outputs retained and reviewed separately.
aggregation.overall_score: None. Report separate coverage, fidelity, citations, proposals, controls and failure/resources.

resources.scope: Wall time and Ollama input/output tokens only; no process/CPU/memory monitoring.
resources.separation: Preparation/index/clustering separate; retrieval, English generation and presentation translation separate. Translation extra calls/cost disclosed.
resources.denominators: Scheduled attempts and timed completed calls explicitly reported; absent timing not zero. Failed calls included if measurements available.
resources.report: Counts, median and range per question/method or timing subset; context length and unique review counts. No monetary estimate for local execution without measured tariff/energy.

human_review_proposal.primary_annotation: Assistant with method labels hidden; not independent evaluation. Same-model auditor not accepted as ground truth.
human_review_proposal.sample: 6 paired cases (12 main answers), one pair per Q1-Q6, two pairs per product. Balanced assignment drawn with prespecified seed 20261119 and hidden method labels; do not select by score.
human_review_proposal.scope: Review factual/proposal/control labels in sampled answers and references as needed; explicit user corrections propagate by rule to analogous cases for both methods, logged before method unblinding.
human_review_proposal.burden: 12 answers proposed, not review all generated statements or stability copies; ambiguous issues outside sample logged separately, no automatic expansion of user review workload.
human_review_proposal.limitation: User knows source material; hiding labels is partial blinding, not independent human annotation or full-corpus validation.

freeze_gate: User review/approval of this rubric, scoring units and denominators
Check applicability and actual passages of references against final corpora/chunks
Calibrate annotation examples on Curly Co. development only, not tune scoring to final method results
Finalize English equivalents, grouping/retrieval parameters, context budgets, run schedule and repetitions
Implement and verify scoring/export checks before final run
Record immutable input/protocol hashes and obtain final freeze authorization
